title: Multimodal Fusion Methods for Whole-Slide Images and Clinical Data in Inflammatory Bowel Disease
abstract: arXiv:2611.05579v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal AI fusion of histology and clinical data is an active research area in computational pathology, but fusion methods are rarely compared under identical conditions and across different clinical endpoints. We present a modular framework in which slide-level embeddings, obtained by training an attention-based aggregator over patch embeddings from a frozen foundation model, and per-visit clinical embeddings are fed into 15 interchangeable fusion methods with a shared output dimension and prediction head (except decision-level methods). Using a prospective cohort of newly diagnosed inflammatory bowel disease patients, we predicted STRIDE-II-aligned remission outcomes from baseline or follow-up visits. The best fusion method reached macro-F1 of 0.57-0.75, outperforming both single-modality models in four of six scenarios, and differed by outcome and input. translated_title: 炎症性肠病中全切片图像与临床数据的多模态融合方法
translated_abstract: 多模态AI融合组织学与临床数据是计算病理学中的一个活跃研究领域，但融合方法很少在相同条件下、跨不同临床终点进行比较。我们提出了一个模块化框架，其中切片级嵌入（通过在冻结的基础模型所产生的补丁嵌入上训练基于注意力的聚合器获得）与每次就诊的临床嵌入被输入到15种可互换的融合方法中，这些方法共享输出维度和预测头（决策级方法除外）。使用一个新诊断炎症性肠病患者的前瞻性队列，我们从基线或随访就诊预测符合STRIDE-II标准的缓解结局。最佳融合方法的宏F1达到0.57–0.75，在六个场景中的四个场景中优于两种单模态模型，且其表现因结局和输入不同而有所差异。图像依赖性，即当切片嵌入被重新（原文此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出了一个模块化框架，在统一条件下系统比较15种多模态融合方法，将全切片图像嵌入与临床数据结合，用于预测炎症性肠病患者的缓解结局，结果显示最佳融合方法在多数场景下优于单模态模型。
en_tdlr: The paper presents a modular framework that systematically compares 15 multimodal fusion methods under identical conditions for combining whole-slide image embeddings with clinical data to predict remission outcomes in inflammatory bowel disease patients, showing that the best fusion method outperforms single-modality models in most scenarios.
